from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string app = Flask(__name__) @app.route('/federation') def federation(): members = request.args.get('members', '') bylaws = request.args.get('bylaws', '') template = '''

United Federation of Planets

Members: {}

Bylaws: {}

'''.format(members, bylaws) return render_template_string(template)
